questions.question: In the self-help group, the loan and saving decisions are taken by the __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**group members.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In a **self-help group,** the **members **collectively take the decisions regarding **loans and savings.**
 
• The group members decide the** terms and conditions** of the **loan,** the **repayment schedule**, the** interest rate**, and the **purpose of the loan.**
 
• The** saving decisions** are also taken by the **group members**, such as the amount to be saved, the frequency of saving, and the purpose of saving.
 
• The self-help group model is based on the** principle of mutual trust and cooperation,** and the group members work together to meet their **financial needs.**
 
• The self-help group model has been successful in promoting** financial inclusion and empowering women** in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Non-government organizations (NGOs)** may provide support and training to self-help groups, but they **do not **make the loan and saving decisions.

 
 
• A non-governmental organization is one that, in most cases, is founded **without the involvement** of the government. 
 
 
 
• **Banks **may provide **loans to self-help groups,** but the terms and conditions of the loan are decided by the group members.
 
 
• A bank is a type of financial institution that lends money while also **taking deposits** from the general public and generating** demand deposits.**
 
 
 
• **Government agencies** may provide policy support and financial assistance to self-help groups, but they **do not** make the loan and saving decisions.
 
 
• A permanent or semi-permanent organization that is part of the political system and is in charge of** overseeing and carrying out** particular duties is known as a government or state agency.

questions.question: Which of the soluble fibres found in fruits is used as a thickener in cooking and baking?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pectin.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pectin** is a **soluble fiber** found in** fruits** that is commonly used as a** thickener in cooking and baking.**
 
• It is particularly useful for **making jams and jellies **as it helps to set the **fruit mixture.**
 
• Pectin is also used in the food industry as a **stabilizer and emulsifier,** and it is found in many processed foods such as **yogurt, ice cream, and salad dressings.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Lignin** is also a type of fiber found in fruits, but it is** not soluble in water** and therefore cannot be used as a thickener.
